faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is conducted by the Revenue Department Sawantwadi for filling up various government job vacancies in the state of Maharashtra across specific talukas like Sawantwadi, Vengurla, and Dodamarg.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in this notification?
faq.answer: The available post under this recruitment notification is Revenue Servant (Kotwal), offering candidates a great opportunity to secure a stable government position.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are announced?
faq.answer: There are a total of 16 vacancies available for the Revenue Servant (Kotwal) position distributed across various categories as per government reservation rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted strictly in offline mode. Candidates need to submit their filled application forms in person at the respective Tahsildar office.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed offline application form is 17-10-2026 till 06.15 PM excluding public holidays.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Revenue Servant (Kotwal) post will receive a fixed consolidated salary of Rs. 15,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. Where can candidates obtain the application form?
faq.answer: Prescribed application forms can be obtained directly from the Tahsildar Offices located in Sawantwadi, Vengurla, and Dodamarg.

faq.question: Q8. Can applications be sent via post or courier?
faq.answer: No, applications sent via post, courier, email, or any other electronic medium will not be accepted by the department. Applications must be submitted by hand.

faq.question: Q9. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a minimum qualification of 10th standard pass or as per the specific recruitment rules outlined in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. Which official website should I visit for more details?
faq.answer: Candidates can visit the official website of Sindhudurg district at www.sindhudurg.nic.in to access recruitment updates, notifications, and further instructions.
